title: A bandwidth refinement of the Erdős distinct subset sums bound
summary: Let $f(n)$ be the least possible largest element of an $n$-element set of positive integers with pairwise distinct subset sums. Dubroff, Fox and Xu proved the finite lower bound \[ f(n)\ge \binom{n}{\lfloor n/2\rfloor} \] by applying a vertex-boundary estimate to the $2^{n-1}$ subsets whose sums lie below half of the total sum. We instead order all $2^n$ subsets by increasing subset-sum value.
